mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_revisions (target_type, target_id, trigger_type, title, content, saved_by, created_at) SELECT 'post', p.post_id, #{trigger}, p.title, p.content, #{savedBy}, NOW() FROM posts p WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}

INSERT INTO content_revisions (target_type, target_id, trigger_type, title, content, saved_by, created_at) SELECT 'comment', c.comment_id, #{trigger}, NULL, c.content, #{savedBy}, NOW() FROM comments c WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.sql: cr.revision_id AS revisionId, cr.target_type AS targetType, cr.target_id AS targetId, cr.trigger_type AS triggerType, cr.title, cr.content, cr.saved_by AS savedBy, u.name AS savedByName, cr.created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM content_revisions cr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cr.saved_by WHERE cr.target_type = 'post' AND cr.target_id = #{postId} ORDER BY cr.revision_id ASC

SELECT FROM content_revisions cr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = cr.saved_by WHERE cr.target_type = 'comment' AND cr.target_id IN (SELECT comment_id FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId}) ORDER BY cr.revision_id ASC
